{{Quote|Y&mdash;you don't look like a pirate. You're not a pirate, are you? Please tell me you're not a pirate.|Ivan Stahl|<ref name="Beyond Redemption" />}}
'''Ivan Stahl''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was among those attempting to settle in the [[Tularan Marsh]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]]. Stahl's settlement was attacked by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who fed his family to the native [[rakghoul]]s, weakening Stahl's hold on sanity; he and the survivors, such as [[Dana Hunt]], were forced to flee to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Brejik's Run Outpost]], where Hunt recruited help in recovering equipment from the pirates so that they could start a new settlement.<ref name="Beyond Redemption" />
